reason: The free first visit gets me in the door, and if it is really cleaner and calmer than CoCo's I would pay $13 on a weekday a couple of times. I would not jump on a membership until I see how it holds up.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $13 a visit adds up fast for one toddler when the library storytime and free play are right there.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or a cheaper 5-visit pack, plus proof after my free visit that it is noticeably cleaner and less crowded than CoCo's.
